claims.claim: Multiple substantially different problem classes are handled by the same TOE backend; only the domain adapter changes.
claims.evidence: toe.voyage.cross_domain_voyage: one TOEMachine; adapter code in no backend trace; core imports no adapter
claims.limitations: backend stages that a problem's structure does not support are skipped (reported), not emulated
claims.scope: 8 problem classes (tabular, explicit causal system, graph, temporal, Python AST, integer recurrence, precision-critical linear system, legacy HR) plus PYTHIA mining telemetry

claims.claim: One backend can solve every possible problem / 10,000 frontend problem forms.
claims.counterevidence: problems without numeric structure, a declared action vocabulary or a transition relation are described, not solved

claims.claim: P(Y|X) can differ from P(Y|do X), and TOE reports both; a counterfactual requires an abducted unit.
claims.evidence: confounded fixture: association slope > 0, interventional effect < 0; rung 3 refused without a factual unit
claims.limitations: linear structural equations; estimates are model-dependent on the supplied graph
claims.scope: linear SCMs, supplied or estimated weights

claims.claim: An effect that is not identified from observed variables is refused, not estimated.
claims.evidence: latent-confounder problems return EFFECT_NOT_IDENTIFIED with effect_released=False

claims.claim: A supplied graph whose testable implications fail in the data is reported STRUCTURE_CONTRADICTED and its effects withheld.
claims.counterevidence: a wrong graph in the true graph's Markov-equivalence class passes every implication test
claims.limitations: one-sided test; latent confounding can mimic implications
claims.scope: local Markov implications, Gaussian partial correlation, Bonferroni

claims.claim: Causal structure, counterfactual abduction, value of information, multi-representation navigation, world-model revision and futures-backed planning each change outcomes when their precondition holds.
claims.counterevidence: families are constructed so the precondition holds; frequency in real workloads is not measured
claims.evidence: relevant families: benefit with non-overlapping 95% CIs; negative controls: parity
claims.scope: held-out randomized task families with negative controls

claims.claim: Exact Q(phi) escalation changes decisions versus float64.
claims.counterevidence: on CPython 3.12 the futures engine's compensated float summation already decides these near-ties correctly: no measured benefit
claims.limitations: the exact path remains the authority inside the declared float error bound; re-measure per interpreter

claims.claim: Observed consequences revise the world model and change a later related decision; learning in one namespace does not revise another.
claims.evidence: canonical voyage: ACQUIRE_EVIDENCE -> contradiction -> revision -> different, VOI-invariant decision; other domain untouched
claims.limitations: revision requires a non-singular design; otherwise uncertainty is widened instead
claims.scope: linear SCM namespaces; OLS revision on post-intervention observations

claims.claim: TOE learning state survives a process restart through THESEUS custody and the recorded decisions replay bit-identically.
claims.evidence: fresh-process recovery test; tampered chain raises SnapshotIntegrityError
claims.limitations: without THESEUS installed, persistence is UNAVAILABLE (no private store)

claims.claim: TOE's geometric layer (Poincare ball on the 11D metric, Sarkar tree embedding, greedy routing, spectral geometry) is verified and changes navigation solvability on walled graphs.
claims.counterevidence: on open grids the hyperbolic route is longer than Euclidean (no advantage)
claims.evidence: metric axioms, geodesics, isometry tests; delivery 1.00 vs 0.61 (Euclidean) on walled grids
claims.limitations: embedding depth bounded by float64 resolution; learning embeddings from data is not implemented

claims.claim: In mining, TOE advises an operational setting; PYTHIA authorizes; SHA256d + target comparison alone decide validity.
claims.evidence: all check_pow candidates independently rechecked; consensus-named variables refused in mining mode; toe/ never references check_pow
claims.limitations: no live pool job (no worker credentials on this host); throughput ratio vs baseline is run-to-run noise, not an advantage
claims.scope: CPU-reference window decision on a regtest-difficulty template

claims.claim: phi-structured nonce ordering improves the probability of finding a valid SHA256d result.
claims.counterevidence: golden-stride vs linear order: hit counts within sampling noise
claims.limitations: ordering can change which nonces are visited first, never the validity probability

claims.claim: The golden family (Z[phi], Lucas, Binet, Cassini, Zeckendorf, Pisot) underlies TOE's exact arithmetic, geometry and ordering structures.
claims.counterevidence: Zeckendorf gives no compression; Lucas ladder is a trade-off, not an advantage
claims.evidence: identities verified exactly to n <= 2000; implementations reused across layers
claims.limitations: structural unity is not evidence of a shared physical phenomenon

claims.claim: Because phi appears in two places, they are the same physical phenomenon.
The finite construction golden icosians -> 2I -> 600-cell -> Laplacian has a positive spectral gap (3-sqrt5)/4.
claims.counterevidence: UNIVERSAL_PRINCIPLE_MAP previously printed 0.381966 for this gap (corrected)
claims.limitations: finite volume; lives in millennium/, read by toe.poincare_yangmills

claims.claim: Continuum Yang-Mills existence and mass gap (Clay problem).
claims.limitations: continuum limit, infinite volume, OS reconstruction and Wightman axioms not established

claims.claim: TOE executes quantum-mathematical formalism (Hilbert states, unitary evolution, Born rule) in software.
claims.evidence: unit-norm states; Born probabilities sum to 1
claims.limitations: software execution of the mathematics; TURING owns VQC execution

claims.claim: TOE runs on, or obtains advantage from, a physical QPU.
Lucas rungs 15, 18, 20 are optimal for intelligence.
claims.limitations: no TOE capability is parameterised by a rung; no comparative measurement exists
